items.title: Will Shade and Dewey Corley Interview, 1960-05-25
items.q: Furry Lewis, he played guitar. Made a record for Wildback.

ctx.x: Furry Lewis, he played guitar. Made a record for Wildback. John Hen wrote a vocation. Some other songs he had to play but I didn't know the rest of the titles of them.
Well, I'm glad to hear he's around. I'm sorry we don't have time to look him up.

items.title: Walter "Furry" Lewis Interview, 1967-05-03
items.q: Well, see, I was with Shade.

ctx.x: Well, I know Gus Cannon and Shade. I got records by them with the jugs. Who else was there?
Well, see, I was with Shade. Gus Cannon, I went with him, but not in the jug band. I and Gus was in New York together. Me and him and a cellar called Mrs. Willie B.
